title: Contact Restrictions and the Initial Service Documentation Due Date
content:
**Contact restrictions desk note — Hardship and Protective Holds.** The contact-route allowance of the initial service documentation on a Military Service Hold request depends on the contact restrictions recorded on the servicemember's placed accounts, as shown in their Placed Consumer Accounts case histories. The allowance is added once to the days allowed for the initial service documentation:

- a recorded no-email restriction, which sends the letter by mail, adds the mail-only days, 7 calendar days;
- otherwise, a recorded no-phone-calls or no-text-messages restriction adds the limited-contact days, 3 calendar days;
- no such restriction adds nothing.

## Combinations

| No-email restriction recorded | No-phone-calls or no-text-messages restriction recorded | Allowance |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes or no | 7 days |
| No | Yes | 3 days |
| No | No | Nothing |

**Reading.** Restrictions recorded on any of the servicemember's placed accounts count. Other kinds of contact restriction are not among those named and add nothing.

**Example (hypothetical).** One of the servicemember's accounts carries a recorded no-text-messages restriction and none carries a no-email restriction: 3 calendar days are added.
